source.snippet: I am currently looking for a solution to copy vast amounts of data. A ETL Framework. We are a subsidy and copy via odbc part of a big database from our parent company on our own servers to work with it. The old software we are using is at the end of it's life-cycle. It was never the best piece of software and we built a lot of workarounds within and around it. Now I would like to set us up for the future. I am looking for a piece of software with which I can copy tables from a database into a new target database.

problem_statement: Small subsidiary companies running legacy ETL pipelines over ODBC need to replace end-of-life data-copy software but struggle to find modern tools that handle their specific pattern (parent-company DB → local server, table-level sync, ODBC source) without expensive enterprise contracts or heavy custom engineering.
target_segment: IT managers and data engineers at subsidiary or mid-market companies running ODBC-based ETL pipelines on aging software
notes: Buyer is clearly in a business/corporate context (subsidiary of a larger company, production data workflows). They are actively searching for a paid replacement — existing vendor is EOL. Pain is real: accumulated workarounds indicate long-term friction. Single signal but strong business intent. Opportunity: niche ETL SaaS or managed service targeting ODBC-source subsidiary setups, priced between DIY open-source complexity and full enterprise cost.
